evidence: The missing_duration_category operator was evaluated on seed 0 (E0020) and converged slightly below the baseline. We now proceed to test the next approved feature operator, video_popularity_bucket.
expected_effect: Bucketing video popularity into categorical bins allows the model to capture non-linear frequency effects, which should mitigate popularity bias more effectively than linear scalar handling.
hypothesis: Applying the video_popularity_bucket operator to convert training-only impression counts into categorical features will improve the model's ability to rank items accurately across different popularity scales.
